sources.excerpt: Six Zero by ThorpyFX | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE ThorpyFX Six Zero LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS FUZZ TREMOLO Description The ThorpyFX Six Zero is an all-analogue Fuzz & tremolo pedal, designed and hand-built in the UK by Adrian Thorpe MBE and renowned pedal wizard Dan Coggins to celebrate 60 years of Andertons Music Co! This unique piece of stompbox history started off as a simple question: how could you reimagine a guitar effect from six decades ago to suit the players & tone tinkerers of today? The resulting sounds range from white-hot sustain to shuddering psychedelic soundscapes, with a near-infinite number of sweet spots in between. SKU: GABV77830082 Category: EFFECTS > ThorpyFX Six Zero Vintage Fuzz Tremolo quantity Add to cart Description The ThorpyFX SIX ZERO is a bold blend of classic inspiration and forward-thinking designcrafted to channel the raw sonic spirit of the 1960s through a modern, premium build. Designed from the ground up to offer a vintage-voiced fuzz with rich modulation, the SIX ZERO delivers a dynamic and musical experience thats equally at home in retro-leaning setups or modern rigs. At its core lies a silicon-based take on the iconic MKI Tone Bender, offering powerful, saturated fuzz tones with excellent articulation and sustain. This is paired with a discrete analog tremolo circuit, originally conceived by Dan Coggins and refined for todays players. The combination creates a versatile, responsive pedal that balances warmth, motion, and grit in a single unit. With intuitive controls for Depth, Rate, Attack, and Level, the SIX ZERO keeps the interface simple while delivering a surprisingly wide tonal palette. Premium components throughout ensure high-fidelity performance, housed in a rugged, custom-engineered enclosure designed to inspire confidence on stage or in the studio.
